summary: Iteration 50 RETEST of 3 iter49 fixes — ALL 3 BUGS VERIFIED FIXED. (1) Partial voucher redemption chain $30 → $10, $12, $8 all succeed; residuals 20 → 8 → 0; statuses partial → partial → redeemed; redemptionCount 1 → 2 → 3. (2) Duplicate transactionId on partially-redeemed voucher returns HTTP 409 ('Voucher already applied to this transaction') — no longer 400 'max reached'. (3) GET /api/transactions returns 200 with 42 rows and _id stripped. GET /api/gift-cards returns 200 with clean list. FRONTEND fully unblocked: /accounting page renders accounting-page, transactions-table with 42 txn-row-* rows, 42 refund-txn-* buttons; opening RefundDialog reveals all 4 add-split buttons (card, store_credit, points, voucher), refund-reason and refund-submit. 35/35 backend tests pass (11 new iter50 regression + 24 iter49 full suite re-run). No regressions on wallet, timeline, loyalty, personalisation, promo-analytics, ai/promotion-goal, refunds/flexible, gift-cards/schedule+reload, voucher bulk/lookup/validate/revoke.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/commerce_v29.py::redeem_voucher — dup-tx guard is now correctly placed BEFORE _validate_voucher_rules (line 294) and the partial-redeem exception at line 302 skips the max-redemptions check when partialRedeemable && residualValue>0. Fix is clean and minimal.
routes/transactions.py::get_transactions — now uses find(query, {'_id':0}) and safe_parse_list; matches the treatment of /promotions and /gift-cards. Good.
routes/transactions.py::get_gift_cards — now uses safe_parse_list to tolerate legacy docs missing balance/initialValue. Good.
commerce_v29.py is still 1006 lines — no change since iter49. Recommend splitting into commerce/voucher.py, wallet.py, refund.py, loyalty.py, personalisation.py, gift_cards.py. Not urgent.
commerce_v29.py::promo_analytics still does an N+1 tx.find per redemption. Recommend batching with $in query. Not urgent.
